coreMemory.english: v. to obtain, receive, buy, or bring something；v. to reach or arrive at a place；v. to become or cause someone or something to become；v. to cause an action to be completed
coreMemory.structure: get better /ˈɡɛt ˈbɛtɚ/（变得更好）；get to work /ˈɡɛt ˈtuː ˈwɝːk/（开始工作；到达工作地点）；get something done /ˈɡɛt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈdʌn/（把某事完成）；get in touch with someone /ˈɡɛt ɪn ˈtʌtʃ ˈwɪð ˈsʌˌmwʌn/（与某人取得联系）

structures.chinese: 开始工作；到达工作地点

coreMemory.commonError: ❌ get touch with someone → ✅ get in touch with someone；❌ get rid something → ✅ get rid of something

commonErrors.note: 在“get in touch with someone”这个常用搭配中，介词 in 负责连接后面的对象或范围，不能省略或随意换成其他介词。
在“get rid of something”这个常用搭配中，介词 of 负责连接后面的对象或范围，不能省略或随意换成其他介词。

coreMemory.example: Your pronunciation will get better with focused practice.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 专注练习会让你的发音变得更好。

meanings.english: to obtain, receive, buy, or bring something
meanings.example: I got a message from my teacher this morning.
meanings.translation: 今天早上我收到了老师的信息。

meanings.english: to reach or arrive at a place
meanings.example: We got to the station just before the train left.
meanings.translation: 我们在火车开走前刚好到达车站。

meanings.english: to become or cause someone or something to become
meanings.example: Your pronunciation will get better with focused practice.
meanings.translation: 专注练习会让你的发音变得更好。

meanings.english: to cause an action to be completed
meanings.example: I want to get this task done before lunch.
meanings.translation: 我想在午饭前完成这项任务。

synonyms.difference: obtain 侧重“获得；取得”。对应的常用英文义是 “to obtain, reach, receive, or become something”。get 在本卡搭配“get better”中表达“得到”；换词时要同时检查宾语和介词。

antonyms.usage: 在“得到”这个义项下，lose（失去；丢失）与 get 形成对比。对应的常用英文义是 “opposite of get”。只在这个明确义项和句型中对比，不把两个词的所有用法都视为相反。

derivatives.note: 多见于复合词或技术语境。
getting 是 get 的常用词族形式，作 n. 使用；对应的常用英文义是 “the act of acquiring something”。
